summary: Small omni wheel with a plastic core and two staggered rows of rounded rollers around the rim. A central hex bore passes through the hub along the wheel axis (z). Three countersunk fasteners are visible on the face, spaced around the hub. The wheel is a short cylinder, narrow compared with its diameter.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat hub face on the +z side, around the central hex bore. It is the drive and mounting interface for the shaft.
Flat hub face on the -z side, around the central hex bore, assumed to mirror the +z face.

notes: The 32 mm diameter and 8 mm bore come from the supplied, unverified product data. The bore is hexagonal, and the 8 mm nominal value is treated as its size. The images show it passing fully through the wheel. Width is not stated anywhere, so the 14 mm z value is a rough estimate from the thickness-to-diameter proportion in the images and should be checked against a datasheet. The fastener head diameters and positions cannot be measured from the images, so they are not listed as holes. The -z face is assumed to match the +z face because it is not visible.
